tail:
Step-3 review complete for group `c` (batch 7 only).

## Verdict

`monads-comonads-and-their-algebras` — **insufficient**. Written to `research/frontier-15-alpha-c-step3-verdicts.json`; reasoning in `research/frontier-15-alpha-c-step3-scaffold-review.md`, findings `B7-1 … B7-13` with a severity table. `scaffold-verdicts.mjs` reads it (5/8 A pages reviewed run-wide; the three unreviewed are group b's).

The general theory is in good shape — both design traps hold (Kleisli associativity precedes the Kleisli category; the limit theorem names strict creation with no preservation hypothesis on `T`), Leinster is nowhere in the harvest, and all fifteen of Beta-7's findings verified from disk and are approved. It fails on one shape: **four blocks are developed with no instance of the thing they define.**

**Blocks `sufficient` (routed to Beta-7, which holds the sources):**

- **B7-1** — eight comonad items, no comonad anywhere. Two Riehl headings (Ex. 5.1.7, Ex. 5.2.6(iv)) are recorded `included` against items containing only their *monad* half, so `coverage-checklist` reads green over the omission. Named the corollary and the interior-comonad example to add.
- **B7-2** — no distributive law is ever exhibited, and the Cheng locator reads "stopping before Example 2.3" — the read range was cut at exactly the last result already planned.
- **B7-3** — the ultrafilter monad, a landmark built from four items, is never computed. All the published machinery for a finite-set example is on disk.
- **B7-4** — "the category of monads" dispositioned `inline` into `def-monad-morphism`, which establishes only the morphisms.

**Repaired directly (B7-5 … B7-10), gates re-run green:**

- **`undeclared-prereq` at step 4** — `thm-the-covariant-power-set-monad` cites an item on `categories-functors-and-natural-transformations-examples` (order 360), outside the declared 80-page closure. Added to `requires`; recomputed — every dep's owning page is now inside, no on-page forward citation.
- **Eleven undeclared load-bearing deps**, several named as inputs in Beta's own contracts: `thm-a-monadic-functor-is-conservative` had nothing saying an equivalence reflects isomorphisms; the distributive-law theorem declared "monad associativity" without `def-monad`; the two universal-property theorems quantify over a supplied adjunction without declaring the adjunction definition or the induced-monad formulas; the three "free X monad" theorems never declared what a monoid/group/module is; three poset conclusions declared only `def-preorder`, which says explicitly it "need not be antisymmetric".
- **An id asserting the negative of its own theorem** — renamed across `pages.json`, `coverage.json` and `proof-contracts.json` (key *and* `scope`). Beta owes the `notes.md` sync; the design-file line is the lead Alpha's at step 4.
- **`fs-the-kleisli-and-eilenberg-moore-categories-are-equivalent-for-every-monad`** denied equivalence of *categories* while its route only showed the comparison functor is not essentially surjective. Kept the strong Statement and supplied a route that closes it: every object of the Kleisli category has one endomorphism or infinitely many, while `{1,e}` in **Mon** has exactly two, and an equivalence is fully faithful. Strategy and deps updated; the argument is written out for the author.
- Two more titles corrected — the preorder theorem stated one direction under an "exactly" id with both `iff` rows `checked`, and the free-module theorem omitted the ring its dependency fixes.

**No split.** 57 items, 58 after B7-1 — legal, and the design intends one page. I pre-adjudicated the contingency instead: examples go on B (the `size` rule is A-pages-only), and if the A page must exceed 60, Beta's cut at item 36 is the one to take.

Not done: I did not reopen the four source PDFs, so harvest faithfulness was checked internally — heading text against the item it's dispositioned into — which is what surfaced B7-1 and B7-4. Whether Riehl Ch. 5 holds a named result absent from all 168 harvested headings is the question step 6 must answer with the PDFs open. `validate-plan` and `depsource` remain unrun as authoritative gates; the manifest isn't spliced until step 4.
